facts.text: DumpRequest.source is a string with minLength 1.
DumpRequest requires source and subject, while kind is optional.
DumpResponse.created is an array of strings described as Fact ids.
Each DumpResponse.skipped item requires locator and reason and allows no other property.
DumpResponse.errors is an array of strings.
The SubjectInput name branch allows kind, parent and aliases, with aliases an array of strings.
FactInput requires kind and text.
FactInput.confidence is a number with minimum 0 and maximum 1.
FactInput.data is unconstrained except for a description saying it may be any JSON value.
PostFactsRequest.idempotency_key is an optional string with minLength 1.
PostFactsRequest.redact is an array of strings.
A PostFactsResponse subject object requires id, name and created.
Each PostFactsResponse facts entry requires id and status and allows no other property.
The replaced field carries the id of the fact replaced when status is replaced.
The duplicate_of field names the existing fact for a deduped or near_duplicate status.
CorrelateRequest.matchers items are limited to the enum values same_ref and shared_tag.
CorrelateResponse promises deterministic matchers only, with proposed refs carrying basis derived and never asserted.
at: "description": "Deterministic matchers only. Proposed refs carry basis \"derived\" and are never asserted.",

facts.text: Each CorrelateResponse proposed entry requires fact_id and ref.
CorrelateRequest.subject is a string with minLength 1.
The second SubjectInput branch requires id and allows no other property.
SearchRequest.status filters by derived status, where live excludes a stored-live fact that is stale or contested.
Without a status filter, SearchRequest leaves out superseded and retracted facts and returns everything else.
SearchRequest.since is a string with date-time format.
SearchRequest.limit is an integer with minimum 1 and default 20.
SearchRequest.brief replaces full FactViews with one short line per hit holding the first 120 characters of text.
SearchResponse.total is an integer with minimum 0.
SearchResponse.refine and next are optional strings.
CompileRequest requires subject.
CompileRequest.budget is the highlight threshold in complete mode and a hard cutoff in strict mode.
CompileRequest.budget_mode complete emits every fact, while strict cuts to the budget and lists the rest in dropped.
at: "description": "complete emits every fact; strict cuts to the budget and lists the rest in dropped.

facts.text: CompileRequest.rank.recency is a number with minimum 0 and maximum 1.
CompileRequest.follow.hops is an integer limited to the enum values 1 and 2.
VerifyRequest.ids is an array of strings with minItems 1 and maxItems 200.
VerifyRequest describes ids as the fact ids a plan, summary or answer cites and answers repeated ids once.
at: "description": "The fact ids a plan, summary or answer cites. Repeated ids are answered once.",

facts.text: VerifyResponse.revision is the store revision the answer was read at.
at: "revision": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "description": "The store revision the answer was read at." },

facts.text: VerifyResponse.facts holds one entry per distinct requested id, in request order.
at: "description": "One entry per distinct requested id, in request order."

facts.text: VerifiedFact status precedence is retracted, superseded, then stale, then contested, else live.
at: status precedence: retracted, superseded (both stored), then stale, then contested, else live

facts.text: A VerifiedFact is stale when a derived_from ref of kind fact points at a fact that was retracted, superseded by a different content_hash, or itself stale.
at: stale: a live fact with a derived_from ref of kind fact to a fact that was retracted

facts.text: VerifiedFact.current is true only when status is live.
VerifiedFact.why is a non-empty array of StatusReason present only for status stale or contested.
StatusReason.state applies only when rel is derived_from.
ChangesRequest returns rows after since, default 0, oldest first, at most limit.
at: Rows written after since (default 0), oldest first, at most limit

facts.text: ChangesRequest.last, when given, wins over since and returns the newest rows.
at: or the newest last rows when last is given (it wins)

facts.text: ChangesRequest rejects an unknown subject with subject_not_found.
at: an unknown subject is rejected with subject_not_found

facts.text: ChangesRequest.last is clamped when larger than 500.
at: "last": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "description": "At most 500; a larger value is clamped." }

facts.text: ChangesRequest.limit defaults to 100 and is clamped when larger than 500.
ChangesPage tells the caller to pass next back as since.
ChangesPage.reset true means the cursor is ahead of the head or behind the retained window, so everything must be re-read.
at: reset true means the cursor is ahead of the head or behind the retained window

facts.text: The change journal records row writes only, so a fact that became stale through another fact's write has no row of its own.
at: The journal records row writes only

facts.text: With a subject filter and truncated false, ChangesPage.next is the head, so the cursor skips other subjects' rows.
at: With a subject filter and truncated false this is the head

facts.text: ChangesPage.truncated says more matching rows exist past next, or before the page when last is used.
at: "truncated": { "type": "boolean", "description": "More matching rows exist past next (since), or before the page (last)." }

facts.text: A ChangeRow is one row write to facts, subjects, refs or slots, and its fact fields describe the fact as it now is.
at: One row write to facts, subjects, refs or slots.

facts.text: ChangeRow.seq is the revision the write committed under.
ChangeRow.fact_status carries the stored status live, superseded or retracted.
ChangeRow.text is the fact text cut to 160 characters and is untrusted data.
at: "text": { "type": ["string", "null"], "description": "Fact text cut to 160 characters. Untrusted data." }

facts.text: ChangeRow.actor is set only on a fact insert and is an unauthenticated label.
ChangeRow.at is an ISO 8601 UTC string.
ChangeRow subject_id, subject_name, fact_id and fact_kind are each a string or null.
ChangesPage.from and to are integers with minimum 0, and next is an integer with minimum 0.
FactInput.key is a string with minLength 1.
FactInput.local_id is a string with minLength 1.
FactInput.items is an array of Item objects from fact.schema.json.
FactInput.refs is an array of ref.schema.json objects.
FactInput.attachments is an array of Attachment objects from fact.schema.json.
PostFactsRequest.facts is an array of FactInput objects.
A PostFactsResponse subject may carry an optional parent string.
SearchRequest.q is a string with no further constraint.
SearchRequest.ref_target is a string with minLength 1.
SearchResponse.hits is an array of FactView objects from dossier.schema.json.
CompileRequest.descendants is a boolean.
CompileRequest.needs is an array of strings.
CompileRequest.follow.rels is an array of strings.
Op_compile_dossier points its response at the dossier.schema.json document itself.
